entities.name: PMID:27495286
observations: 2017 controlled study compared 14-day TPN using SMOFlipid or Intralipid with sow-fed controls in neonatal piglets; lipid dose was 10 g/kg/day.
Ileal microbiota profiled by 16S rRNA sequencing and mucosal host-gene expression measured.

entities.name: Piglet microbiota shifts by emulsion
observations: Ileal microbiota differed between TPN and sow-fed piglets and between SMOFlipid and Intralipid groups (AMOVA, P<.05); SMOFlipid profiles were more similar to sow-fed controls by UniFrac (P<.05). Intralipid increased Parabacteroides; SMOFlipid increased Enterobacteriaceae (P<.05).

entities.name: Piglet mucosal response differs
observations: TPN increased mucin, claudin 1, beta-defensin 2, and interleukin 8 expression; increases were significantly smaller with SMOFlipid than Intralipid (P<.05).
